task.title: M8: Generic metric overlays ({path, metric} files on treemap, graph, and map)
task.description:
Add one generic door for external per-file data so coverage, bundle bytes, error counts, review density, etc. can all be shown without a feature per source. An overlay is a JSON or CSV file of {path, value} rows (paths relative to the repo root, numeric values) plus a small header (name, unit, optional min/max, color scale direction). The CLI accepts --overlay <file> on serve and export (repeatable), the server exposes GET /api/overlays and GET /api/overlays/:name, and the UI adds the overlay names to the existing color-mode selector (next to complexity and churn) on the treemap, graph, and map views. Files with no row render in the neutral color. Keep overlays out of the snapshot cache: they are ephemeral inputs attached at serve/export time, not analysis results.

Acceptance criteria:
- codeviz serve --overlay coverage.json makes a 'coverage' color mode available in the treemap, graph, and map views; files without a value render neutral; hover shows the value and unit.
- Overlay paths are matched after the same normalization the walker uses (forward slashes, no leading ./); unmatched rows are counted and reported once on stderr, not silently dropped.
- Export copies overlays into the static site and the StaticDataSource serves them, so a published site has the same color modes.
- Provide one converter in the repo for an lcov file to the overlay format (lines-covered percentage per file) as the reference example; no other converters in this story.
- One test for the overlay parser and path matching; no new runtime dependencies.
